name: plzzz-launch-video
description: 30s 1:1 launch video for plzzz.bond, rendered with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchVideo out/plzzz-launch-1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && ffmpeg -y -i out/plzzz-launch-1080.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.0:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/plzzz-launch-video.mp4
